baseline_interpretation: Because the prepared data is StandardScaler output, 0 corresponds to the training-data mean of each feature.
contribution_definition: original anomaly score - anomaly score after replacing one feature with the neutral baseline
positive_contribution_meaning: Removing the feature lowers the anomaly score; the feature contributed to the anomaly.
negative_contribution_meaning: Removing the feature raises the anomaly score; the feature made the sample look relatively more normal.
